Hi Mayra,

We run an intensive outpatient program in San Antonio for binge eating, chronic over-eating and food addiction: group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education, in one program. It is in network with most health insurance plans, and clients attend onsite or by Zoom.

Would you add us to the Eating Disorders section at https://vitalitylifecounselingsa.com/mental-health-links? Our homepage is https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/ and the link text could be "Bariatric Counseling Center of San Antonio (binge eating and overeating program)".

In return we will list Vitality Life Counseling as a referral partner on our website, and we are glad to refer clients who need individual therapy outside our program.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center, San Antonio
www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com

That question is at the heart of Mindful Eating and Coping Skills, part of our Behavioral Therapy & Counseling pillar. We help people understand and modify their relationship with food, not through rules or restriction, but through awareness and compassion.

Our program includes group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education. One program, not four.

Serving clients in San Antonio and virtual across Texas.

## What is bariatric surgery counseling?

Bariatric surgery counseling is behavioral health support that helps people prepare for weight loss surgery or address eating and emotional challenges after the procedure. It typically involves working with licensed therapists, psychologists, and registered dietitians to understand eating patterns, build coping skills, and develop sustainable habits around food and movement. At the Bariatric Counseling Center in San Antonio, we provide this counseling as part of our Intensive Outpatient Program, available onsite at our San Antonio facility and virtually throughout Texas. Our program includes group and individual therapy, dietary guidance from registered dietitians, cooking classes with a professional chef, and movement education. We coordinate care with medical providers and are in network with most health insurance plans, with claims processed under mental health benefits.

1. developers.facebook.com: create an app (type Business), add the Facebook Login and Instagram Graph products.
